title: Cloud platform decision
transcript:
Platform Engineering Lead: Alright everyone, let's dive into the cloud platform options. I've done some initial research and we have three options on the table: AWS Outposts, Google Anthos, and Azure Stack.

SRE: I've looked into Azure Stack as well, and while it's powerful, the high initial cost and potential long-term maintenance burden outweighs the benefits for our current scale.

CTO: I agree with the SRE's assessment. Let's focus on AWS Outposts and our custom solution.

Finance Partner: With AWS Outposts, we can leverage their expertise and infrastructure, but our custom solution offers better control and fit for our unique banking workloads. Building offers a long-term strategic advantage over buying.

Platform Engineering Lead: That's a good point, but we need to be mindful of the potential long-term maintenance load of a custom solution.

CTO: Absolutely, and that's why I propose a provisional decision to build our custom cloud platform, pending a cost analysis comparison with AWS Outposts. We'll ensure we're making the best ROI decision.

SRE: I understand and support the decision, but I'd like to stress again the potential long-term maintenance load of a custom solution.

Platform Engineering Lead: I'll make sure to allocate resources accordingly and keep the team's workload manageable.

Finance Partner: I'll prepare a detailed cost comparison between building and AWS Outposts for our next meeting.

CTO: Great. Let's move on to other agenda items, but first, a brief off-topic exchange. SRE, how was your weekend?

SRE: Not bad, thanks for asking, CTO. I spent some time trying out a new board game. It was... interesting.

CTO: Ah, the joys of exploring new games. Let's get back to business. Platform Engineering Lead, will you own the custom cloud platform project?

Platform Engineering Lead: I will, CTO. I'm looking forward to the challenge.

CTO: Excellent. With that said, I sign off on the provisional decision to build our custom cloud platform, pending the cost analysis comparison. Let's circle back on this in our next meeting.

Platform Engineering Lead: Understood, CTO. Let's make it happen.

Title: Discussion on Cloud Infrastructure Strategy

Platform Engineering Lead presented options for cloud infrastructure: AWS Outposts and Azure Stack, as well as a custom solution tailored to our banking workloads. Following consideration, it was determined that the high initial cost and potential long-term maintenance burden associated with Azure Stack is not suitable for our current scale. The CTO was in agreement that a custom solution offers better control and a more precise fit for our unique workloads. Further analysis will be conducted to compare costs and ensure the best return on investment for both building and AWS Outposts. No decision has been made at this time.
